batches.title: Repetition fix: form genome v3 vs real pop (blind test)
batches.notes: Response to 'random but formulaic / one trick repeated': the critics were found to reward repetition without limit (an audit of real phrases with injected loops), so they were retrained with over-repetition fakes and the GA's own output; likelihood judges now prefer typical real values instead of a flat band; judges combine as a geometric mean (all must agree); the archive tracks rhythm repetition and pulls toward where real pop is densest; new bars are sampled from corpus statistics so new material is as cheap as a repeat. 'Sounds real' = independent grader 3 (never optimised against). 'reference' = mainstream pop excerpts.
